plugins.name: dsh-base
plugins.description: The shared dsh core as a profile bundle: every profile's first patch layer, inserting the base plugin rows over the empty profile root

plugins.name: dsh-web-app
plugins.description: The browser-surface bundle: the web patch layer over dsh-base plus the runtime glue plugin (frontend dist serving, web-surface prompt, URL line)

plugins.name: dsh-headless
plugins.description: The one-shot bundle: a direct core Agent/Session runner over dsh-base with no Host, HTTP, or browser layer

plugins.name: dsh-hooks-claude-code
plugins.description: Bridge plugin: runs an existing Claude Code hooks.json on the harness interception seams (command hooks only; http, mcp_tool, prompt, and agent hooks are skipped with a warning)

plugins.name: dsh-hooks-codex
plugins.description: Bridge plugin: runs a Codex hooks.json on the harness interception seams (regex-only matchers, snake_case payloads, only blocking decisions honored)

plugins.name: modlens
plugins.description: Vision plugin for text-only models: image understanding bridged into the harness via a dsh.bundle patch layer, shipping a modlens skill alongside

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui
plugins.description: Plugin and skin collection for the dsh Web UI: task board, git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, live token stats, and a skin center that routes around the theme-persistence gap

plugins.name: colleague-skill
plugins.description: Digital-companion skill in the Anthropic SKILL.md format dsh reads; install by copying it into a dsh skill root such as .agents/skills
